definition: An application or service that advises farmers, herders, fishers or extension agents what to do on their farm or herd given weather or climate conditions. Does not include water allocation or drought response by authorities (drought and water management), nor tools for planners.
An application that advises authorities or utilities on water allocation, irrigation scheduling or drought response. Does not include farm-level crop advice (farm and livestock advisory).

A tool that helps public planners or asset managers decide which adaptation measures or investments to make, such as climate-informed asset management or investment prioritisation systems. Does not include advice to households, firms or farmers.

A digital tool that combines climate risk data with household or social registry data to decide whom to support (cash transfers, protection) when a climate shock hits. Does not include advisory applications or planners' investment tools.

type_name: Advisory to households, firms and communities
definition: An application that advises households, businesses or communities, outside farming and water management, how to act given climate conditions. Does not include farm advice, water management or tools for public planners.
